name: Hunger

text.trigger: One card brings a man and a helpless survivor to the colony together (an Outsiders card).
text.vignette: The newcomer would like to join, but he comes with a heavy companion who eats like three people and is plainly the reason his pack is so light. He explains in a low voice that he promised to look after him, then names what he is willing to trade.

options.let-him-eat: The big man empties the stores: all the food in the supply is removed.
options.share-the-strange-meat: Accept the stranger's offering of unnamed meat: 5 food is added to the supply and morale falls by 1.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #12; Male survivors: every named survivor of the roster except Alexis, Annaleigh, Ashley, Bev, Carla, Janet, Jenny, Loretta, Maria, Olivia, Sophie, Sparky, Talia. Fires after a card (the Outsiders) adds a survivor and a helpless token.
